research: The catalogue does not date this individual item. The date range is inherited from the collection record and does not establish the date of this passage. The catalogue entry names Hans Jörgen Rosenberg and Hermann Jürgen Stricker alongside successive named mayors and others. 1568-1773.json also pairs a Johann Georg Rosenberg and Stricker in the same volume, suggesting a possible shared context without proving identity. Brakel has similarly named Rosenbergs (ai_2026.json), but the excerpt gives no town, individual date, or link to that family. Attribution was initially unresolved. Further comparison supports a tentative Brakel attribution: the Brakel citizenship register records Urbanus Jordan with wife Elisabeth Gogreben in 1670, matching the unusual Jordan/Gogreffen association in 1568-1773_2.json, and records Strickers and a Johan Jürgen Rosenberg family in Brakel. The two Rosenberg/Stricker references in volume 2 reinforce a shared local context, although the precise relationships and individual identities remain unproven. The neighboring inventory item 1727.json explicitly concerns Brakel but its shared B 605 collection alone cannot locate this specific volume.
